optimizedDescription.value: Composes curated Core and Code Graph host APIs without exposing infrastructure or delivery dependencies.

optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Composition

## Rules

- `@specd/sdk` lives `packages/sdk/`; runtime deps only `@specd/core`, `@specd/code-graph`; never CLI, MCP, plugins.
- Source may use composition/orchestration/presentation/shared/domain. Domain limited to SDK errors/values; no entities, ports, adapters. `src/shared/` has no public subpath, though curated barrel may export named required binding.
- Package exports: `.` built from curated `src/index.ts`; `./ports` re-exports `@specd/core/ports`; `./extensions` re-exports `@specd/core/extensions`.
- Root explicitly exports SDK composition (`openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, `withOpenGraphProvider` and types), orchestration (`buildProjectStatusSnapshot`, `runIndexProjectGraph`, implementation review and types), presentation, curated Core/Graph APIs, `SDK_VERSION`, `codeGraphVersion`, `getCodeGraphVersion`.
- Curated Core surface tracks kernel specs, metadata materialize/read/regenerate/init, persisted schema/dependency/implementation/optimization use cases and factories. Never export removed `SaveSpecMetadata`, `UpdateSpecMetadata`, `InvalidateSpecMetadata`, factories, or internal `PersistSpecMetadata`.
- Host-adapter Graph exports include `runIsolatedGraphIndex` contracts/typed failures, graph health inputs/results/factory, index/hotspot/impact types, `GraphSpecNotFoundError`, symbol/search/risk options, selector/config/fingerprint helpers, reference/logical-symbol/binding/member/coverage/health/resolver types.
- Never export raw graph locks/tokens/helpers, worker IPC, infrastructure adapters, internal composition, or dependency `./internal` symbols. Hosts use high-level isolated worker for writes and provider/use cases for reads.
- Hosts needing Core+Graph depend/import only `@specd/sdk`; Core-only plugins/skills may import Core. Storage implementers may use Core/SDK ports and extensions.
- `SDK_VERSION` matches package version.

## Constraints

- Thin composition/orchestration; no duplicated bootstrap/infrastructure.
- Presentation performs no I/O.
- `src/shared/` private; root barrel explicit, never wildcard Core export.
